lane.name: Valley Verified App Build Lane

Gives staff one clean route for inventory, specials, media, socials, and visit details.
Lets Valley Verified show what a featured retail customer could receive after buying an app build lane.
Keeps age-sensitive retail presentation behind an explicit 21+ screen before product exploration.
